newsitem.title: USA: USAir might order new jetliners - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: USAir might order new jetliners - WSJ.

text.p: USAir Group Inc is thinking about ordering up to 120 new jetliners in a deal worth more than $5 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The newspaper cited unidentified sources as saying the airline had been talking with Boeing Co, Airbus Industrie and McDonnell Douglas Corp.
Boeing appeared to be closest to clinching a deal, it said, adding that financing appeared to be a major issue in the negotiations.
The newspaper said USAir and the aircraft manufacturers confirmed that they were involved in the talks but declined to elaborate.
